verdict.rationale: The evidence shows a REST API reference page listing endpoints such as GET /v1/events and GET /v1/links/{link_id}/slots, plus security schemes (OAuth2, Bearer, personal access tokens). Its formatting resembles a page rendered from an OpenAPI spec, but no item documents a downloadable OpenAPI or equivalent machine-readable spec file. A human-readable API reference is an adjacent feature and earns no credit for this story.
